entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:1
segments: But of the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that I write to you.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:2
segments: For you yourselves know accurately that the day of [the] Lord comes like a thief in the night.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:3
segments: For when they shall say, Peace and safety! Then sudden destruction comes on them, as travail upon a woman with child. And they shall not escape.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:4
segments: But you, brothers, are not in darkness, that the Day should overtake you like a thief.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:5
segments: You are all the sons of light and the sons of the day. We are not of the night, or of darkness.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:6
segments: Therefore let us not sleep as the rest [do], but let us watch and be calm.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:7
segments: For those sleeping sleep in the night, and those being drunken are drunken in the night.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:8
segments: But let us, who are of the day, be calm, having put on [the] breastplate of faith and love and [the] hope of salvation [for] a helmet.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:9
segments: For God has not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:10
segments: who died for us, so that whether we watch or sleep we should live together with Him.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:11
segments: Therefore comfort one another, and edify one another, even as you also do.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:12
segments: And, brothers, we beseech you to know those who labor among you, and are over you in [the] Lord, and who admonish you,

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:13
segments: and to esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:14
segments: Now we exhort you, brothers, warn those who are unruly, comfort the faint-hearted, support the weak, be patient toward all.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:15
segments: See [that] none gives evil for evil to anyone, but always pursue the good, both towards one another and towards all.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:16
segments: Rejoice evermore.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:17
segments: Pray without ceasing.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:18
segments: In everything give thanks, for this [is the] will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:19
segments: Do not quench the Spirit.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:20
segments: Do not despise prophesying.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:21
segments: Prove all things, hold fast to the good.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:22
segments: Abstain from every appearance of evil.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:23
segments: And may the God of peace Himself sanctify you, and may your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless to the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:24
segments: Faithful [is] He who called you, who also will do [it].

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:25
segments: Brothers, pray for us.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:26
segments: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:27
segments: I charge you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:28
segments: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you. Amen.
